Welcome to PIMCO Prime Real Estate
We are looking for an intern (m/f/d) to join us at one of our modern and innovative locations in Munich or Stuttgart.
Our global Portfolio and Investor/Client team is based across offices in Germany, France, Switzerland, the USA and Singapore. Collaboration on a wide range of global projects provides a varied day-to-day role in an international working environment.
We offer you insight into all areas of portfolio management across the entire real estate investment lifecycle, as well as the related requirements of managing client relationships and implementing portfolio objectives. The team is involved in investment decisions ranging from transaction assessments and ongoing analysis to the strategic positioning of our existing portfolio and potential divestment processes. The portfolio we manage includes investments in Germany, Austria, the UK, Eastern Europe and Scandinavia, providing exciting insights into a range of dynamic real estate markets.
In addition, our team is responsible for the following areas of portfolio management: assessment of potential developments, acquisitions and disposals; strategic development and optimization of the existing portfolio (Asset Strategy & Business Plan Review); management; Investor/Client Reporting; and performance analyses. We value active and open communication and work closely with clients and investors as well as all internal PPRE departments, including Asset Management, Transactions and Finance.
What you will do:
Supporting team members across their respective areas, gaining detailed insights into a variety of responsibilities and, following successful onboarding, taking ownership of selected tasks, including independent analyses
Gaining insight into operational real estate decisions and the active management of one of Europe’s largest institutional real estate portfolios
Supporting portfolio analyses and gaining related insights, including in interdisciplinary and/or international projects
Contributing to presentations and decision-making materials for internal and external stakeholders in a national and international environment, including the data-driven preparation of portfolio and performance information
Contributing to projects and workstreams aimed at further developing digital workflows and analytical processes, for example through business intelligence, automation and AI solutions
What you bring:
Currently studying economics, business administration or a related field, ideally with a focus on real estate and preferably having completed a bachelor's degree
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, including structured data preparation and the creation of professional presentations
Initial practical experience with, or a strong interest in, modern digital solutions, particularly business intelligence tools such as Power BI, the automation or programming of Office applications, and the responsible use of AI-enabled tools
Initiative, a quick grasp of new concepts, and a structured and responsible approach to work Initial experience with real estate investment cash flow models is an advantage
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.
Our highlights for you:
Remuneration: In addition to an attractive salary, you can expect a monthly travel allowance of €30.00 and a daily lunch allowance in our excellent staff restaurants.
Career development: Comprehensive educational opportunities in the form of training courses and access to LinkedIn Learning enable continuous further development.
You can find a complete overview of what makes us an attractive employer at careers.allianz.com/benefits.
Appointment date: from 01.02.2027 onwards
Are you interested? Then we look forward to receiving your application online on our careers page - careers.allianz.com.
Our colleagues at recruiting-operations@allianz.de will be happy to answer any technical or professional questions you may have.
Note: Allianz in Germany has an internal recruitment team that focuses on the direct search for outstanding candidates. No unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies or recruitment firms will be accepted.
PIMCO Prime Real Estate
A leading global real estate investor and manager, PIMCO Prime Real Estate is a PIMCO company and part of the PIMCO real estate platform, focusing on the Core and Core+ segments of the market and managing the Allianz Group’s $85B real estate mandate.
We manage a global investment portfolio c. $90B AUM, with an international team of c. 450 employees working in 16 offices in Belgium, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, the UK and the U.S.
PIMCO’s real estate platform is one of the largest and most diversified in the world, with $174B in assets and a broad set of solutions that leverage decades of expertise across public and private equity and debt markets.

110169.text:
Job purpose / role
As a key part of the investment process at Allianz Investment Management SE, you will be supporting the Sustainable Investing team. There are two primary topics you will focus on: supporting the integration of sustainability aspects in our global portfolio, and supporting our corporate ESG engagement program. We expect you to have prior knowledge and interest in sustainability related topics.
We welcome applications from students that are in the advanced stages of their degree and that are seeking a working student or internship role (or combination of both), for six months or longer.
Key responsibilities
Support ESG related monitoring and reporting of the ca. EUR 700bn portfolio
Contribute to analyses of big amounts of investment and sustainability related data
Support internal sustainability related projects and processes (report writing, ESG data collection, research and analytics)
Coordinate, prepare and debrief engagement calls including pre-call planning, drafting meeting minutes and record keeping, assessing outcomes and preparing follow ups
Perform research and analyses on companies’ sustainability performance, flagged concerns, or thematic topics
Track progress and follow up on engagement commitments with respective internal stakeholders
Ad-hoc requests (e.g. preparation of presentations, capital market research, portfolio analysis)
Research and follow developments in sustainable business and write internal news articles on them
Key requirements / Skills / Experience
Advanced stage of your degree in Business Administration, Economics, Financial Mathematics, Political Science, or Environmental Science with a genuine interest in finance, sustainability and climate change mitigation
Very good knowledge of MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, and MS Word
Strong analytical and data analysis skills
Strong research skills and writing, with the ability to interpret data and repackage it into reports or power point presentations with a cohesive narrative for senior management
Excellent team player and enjoy working in an international environment and comfortable interacting with a variety of internal and external senior stakeholders
In-depth academic knowledge of, or strong interest in, capital markets and sustainability topics (e.g. impact investing, SDGs, climate change, engagement)
Good academic grades and professional proficiency in English
Prior working experiences and internships
Hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate research and analysis and to support the team in embedding AI solutions into business processes, combined with a critical mindset and a solid understanding of responsible use
Additional information
In order to consider your application properly, we kindly ask for the following documents from your side: CV, Cover Letter, Employer testimonials / references or recommendation letters (if any), University grades/transcripts of records and high-school transcript (if possible) and your current Certificate of enrolment. Please upload these documents when applying for the role.
You must be registered as student for the entire duration of the internship.
Entry date at 01.03.2027, 6 months full-time is preferred.

Willkommen bei der Allianz
Für unseren modernen und innovativen Standort Stuttgart suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für 6 Monate einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) in Vollzeit, als Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum.
Wir betreuen im Maklervertrieb Leben unsere Geschäftspartner*innen mit Herz und Leidenschaft und sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen, innovativen Ideen für unseren Social-Media-Auftritt im B2B-Bereich. Wir wollen uns mit unseren Produkten und Lösungen zielgruppengerecht präsentieren. Lass uns gemeinsam die Versicherungsbranche verändern.
Das erwartet Dich bei uns als Praktikant (m/w/d) Marketing & Social Media Maklervertrieb Leben (Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum)
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer LinkedIn- und Instagram-Kanäle „Insight Allianz Leben Maklervertrieb“ im Bereich Leben und bringst dabei deine eigenen Ideen ein.
Du konzipierst, erstellst und veröffentlichst B2B-Inhalte in Text und Bild, mit Schwerpunkt auf Videocontent. Dabei entscheidest du selbst, welche Formate und Themen zu unserer Zielgruppe passen.
Du wertest regelmäßig unsere Social-Media-Kennzahlen aus, leitest daraus eigene Empfehlungen ab und steuerst damit unsere Themen- und Redaktionsplanung mit.
Du spürst eigenständig neue Trends und Formate auf Social Media auf, testest neue Ideen und bringst sie proaktiv ins Team ein.
Du planst und setzt Marketingmaßnahmen wie Einladungen, Gewinnspiele oder Aktionen um, von der Gestaltung bis zur Verteilung, und trägst das Ergebnis mit.
Du arbeitest selbstständig und mit viel Gestaltungsfreiraum in einem dynamischen, jungen Team in Stuttgart. Du wirst dabei von erfahrenen Kolleg*innen begleitet und hast feste Ansprechpersonen für Fragen und Feedback. Home-Office ist möglich.
Das bringst Du mit als Praktikant (m/w/d) Marketing & Social Media Maklervertrieb Leben (Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum)
Du bist in einem fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder frühen Masterstudium in den Bereichen Marketing, Kommunikations- oder Medienwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert.
Du bringst Praxiserfahrung im Videoschnitt und in der Bildbearbeitung mit (z. B. mit Tools wie Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut oder Canva) und kannst Videos und Beiträge eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung erstellen.
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Social Media sowie für aktuelle Trends und Tools und konntest bereits praktische Erfahrung sammeln, idealerweise mit eigenem Content oder in Projekten, Praktika oder Nebenjobs.
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Sprache und Storytelling und kannst komplexe Versicherungsthemen verständlich und zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten.
Du bist kommunikativ und offen, bringst viel Motivation mit und arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert.
Du bist kreativ, übernimmst schnell Verantwortung und entwickelst eigene Ideen, die du anschließend selbst umsetzt.
Offenheit für kreative und innovative Lösungen sowie Freude am Umgang mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien wie Künstliche Intelligenz oder internes ChatGPT .
Unsere Highlights für Dich
Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Zahlreiche Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote sowie Präventionsmaßnahmen legen den Grundstein für deine körperliche und mentale Gesundheit.
Vergütung: Neben einer attraktiven Vergütung erwartet dich ein monatlicher Fahrtkostenzuschuss in Höhe von 30,00 € sowie ein täglicher Mittagessenszuschuss in unseren hervorragenden Mitarbeitendenrestaurants.
Zeit & Flexibilität: Mit unserem Modell „Neues Arbeiten“ können Beruf und Privatleben noch besser vereinbart werden. Wir arbeiten flexibel, hybrid, mobil und vor Ort.
Karriereentwicklung: Umfassende Bildungsmöglichkeiten in Form von Schulungen sowie Zugang zu LinkedIn Learning oder Degreed ermöglichen eine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.
Eine vollständige Übersicht darüber, was uns als Arbeitgeber attraktiv macht, findest du unter careers.allianz.com/benefits.
